chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Kathīr narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
that a man asked him about recitation behind the Imam, so he said:
"No. The Imam is responsible for the recitation, but the Imam does not take responsibility for the salat (prayer) of those who are behind him; he only takes responsibility for the recitation."

key_terms.ضَامِنٌ: responsible for or bearing liability for
key_terms.مِنْ خَلْفِهِ: those praying behind him in congregation
key_terms.ٱلْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.ٱلْقِرَاءَةِ: the recitation in salat (prayer), especially recitation of the Qur'an

ai.seo_question: Is recitation required behind the Imam in congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about congregational salat (prayer), stating that the Imam bears the recitation on behalf of those praying behind him. However, each follower remains responsible for his own salat (prayer) in all other respects, so the Imam's guarantee is limited specifically to the recitation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1103 - Al-Hussain ibn Kathir narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that a man asked him about reciting (Qur'an) behind the Imam (during prayer).
No, the Imam is responsible for the recitation, but the Imam does not take responsibility for the prayers of those behind him; he is only responsible for the recitation."
